event_summary: A transparent spherical shell on a dark base shows pale star-shaped patches gradually changing position and distribution while the shell and background remain visually still.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a large transparent spherical shell centered in the frame, partly hidden along its bottom by a dark uneven foreground. Pale translucent folded star-like patches are already visible within the shell silhouette, especially near the upper and central areas. Over the sequence, these pale patches shift in visible placement and grouping: the central area becomes more open, while many patches appear nearer the left, right, and upper rim regions. By the end, a broad clear central region is visible, with pale star-like patches mostly around the perimeter and a few blurred patches still inside the shell silhouette.

reasons: The transparent spherical shell is visible from the start.
The pale star-like patches are already present in the first frame.
The bottom of the shell and some lower patches are partly hidden by the dark foreground.
